_about: Public-domain Frederick Franklin Shannon (1877-1947), minister of the Reformed Church on the Heights, Brooklyn, and of Central Church, Chicago, for the Word Hoard: his books of sermons and essays printed before 1930: The Soul's Atlas (1911), The New Personality (1915), The Enchanted Universe (1916), The Breath in the Winds (1918), God's Faith in Man (1919), The Infinite Artist (1921), The Country Faith (1922), The New Greatness (1923), A Moneyless Magnate (1923) and The Unfathomable Christ (1926). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 83 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
